diagnostics.message: module.eks-addons builds AWS-managed IAM policy ARNs (AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy, AmazonPrometheusRemoteWriteAccess, CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy, etc.) using local.aws.partition, which resolves to module.aws.partition.partition. The dependency graph has no edge from module.eks-addons to module.aws, so the partition data source chain feeding those policy ARNs is not expressed.

resource.local_file.halconfig renders the Spinnaker halconfig template with local.aws.id and local.aws.region (i.e., module.aws.caller.account_id and module.aws.region.name), so its content depends on data from module.aws, but no dependency on module.aws is present in the graph.
